title.narrative: Programme Estimate with the Office of the Head of the Local Government Service

description.narrative: ''Support to the Office of the Head of the Local Government Service in collaboration with the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection to implement and institutionalise effective coordination mechanisms at the decentralised level, through technical assistance and capacity building and with a focus on establishing strong linkages between social protection and active labour market interventions at the decentralised level''. The activities to be implemented are categorized under six result areas; Effective coordination and cooperation of the Ministry of Gender, Children and Social Protection, Ministry of Employment and Labour Relations and the Office of the Head of the Local Government Service at the national and local levels established; Institutional Capacity improvement; Administrative, Logistical and Infrastructural support; Efficient and Effective Sustainable Monitoring and Evaluation System; Visibility and Awareness of programmes; Specific sectorial issues to establish linkages between social protection and active labour market interventions.
